display_long_description:
ILIVEON Media Player App allows you to watch your Videos, Music, Images and Digital Stories (that you create with our Creator App) in Virtual Reality (VR) mode. 

Just load a Video, Music, Sound, or Digital Story ILO File (produced with I-LIVE-ON's Creator App, available from https://i-live-on.com/pages/creator-app ), pick your VR environment and then enjoy the presentation.

I-LIVE-ON's StoryTeller System lets you create Stories using your own information (including Pictures, Videos, Documents and Sound) from your Computer, and then makes it super easy for the Story to be assembled as a multi-media presentation transformed into a VR environment through our VR Media Player App.

USE CASES:

a) A Grandparent, together with their Child / Grandchild, team up to create a Story using all their computer images, videos, documents & sound files to create an interesting Story that they can watch in their VR Headset (and also simultaneously stream to their TV set).

b)  A Student needs to create a multi-media Presentation in Virtual Reality mode of an historical person for a school homework assignment. They can then stream the VR Presentation onto a TV set for their classmates to watch.

Visit https://i-live-on.com/pages/creator-app and download the Free Trial Creator App (for Windows or MacOS Computers) and create your own Stories in minutes, then watch them using your Quest VR Headset together with the ILIVEON VR Media Player App.
